verses.en: Hearken, O ye elders of my church, and give ear to the voice of the living God; and attend to the words of wisdom which shall be given unto you, according as ye have asked and are agreed as touching the church, and the spirits which have gone abroad in the earth.
verses.sm: Faalogo mai ia, outou toeaina e o la’u ekalesia, ma ua’i mai o outou taliga i le siufofoga o le Atua soifua; ma auai atu i upu o le poto o le a tuuina atu ia te outou, e pei ona outou ole mai ai ma autasi i ai e faatatau i le ekalesia, ma agaga ua o atu i le salafa o le lalolagi.

verses.en: Behold, verily I say unto you, that there are many spirits which are false spirits, which have gone forth in the earth, deceiving the world.
verses.sm: Faauta, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o le tele o agaga o i ai o ni agaga sese, ua o atu i le lalolagi, ua faaseseina le lalolagi.

verses.en: And also Satan hath sought to deceive you, that he might overthrow you.
verses.sm: Ma ua saili foi Satani e faasese outou, ina ia mafai ona ia faatoilalo outou.

verses.en: Behold, I, the Lord, have looked upon you, and have seen abominations in the church that profess my name.
verses.sm: Faauta, o A’u, o le Alii, ua Ou vaai ifo ia te outou, ma ua Ou iloa mea inosia i totonu o le ekalesia ua tauaveina lo’u igoa.

verses.en: But blessed are they who are faithful and endure, whether in life or in death, for they shall inherit eternal life.
verses.sm: Ae amuia lava i latou o e ua faamaoni ma tutumau, pe i le olaga nei po o i le oti, ona o le a maua e i latou le ola e faavavau.

verses.en: But wo unto them that are deceivers and hypocrites, for, thus saith the Lord, I will bring them to judgment.
verses.sm: Ae oi talofa ia te i latou o e o ni taufaasese ma pepelo, aua, ua faapea ona fetalai mai o le Alii, o le a Ou aumai i latou i le faamasinoga.

verses.en: Behold, verily I say unto you, there are hypocrites among you, who have deceived some, which has given the adversary power; but behold such shall be reclaimed;
verses.sm: Faauta, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o loo i ai e e pepelo i totonu o outou, o e ua latou faaseseina ni isi, lea ua tuuina atu ai i le fili le mana; ae faauta o le a toe aumaia i latou;

verses.en: But the hypocrites shall be detected and shall be cut off, either in life or in death, even as I will; and wo unto them who are cut off from my church, for the same are overcome of the world.
verses.sm: Ae o e e pepelo o le a iloa i latou ma o le a vavae ese, pe i le olaga nei po o i le oti, e pei lava ona Ou loto i ai; ma oi talofa ia te i latou o e e vavae ese mai la’u ekalesia, ona o i latou lava ia ua manumalo i ai le lalolagi.

verses.en: Wherefore, let every man beware lest he do that which is not in truth and righteousness before me.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, ia faaeteete ai tagata taitoatasi nei faia e ia se mea ua lē moni ma lē amiotonu i o’u luma.

verses.en: And now come, saith the Lord, by the Spirit, unto the elders of his church, and let us reason together, that ye may understand;
verses.sm: Ma o lenei o mai ia, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii, e ala i le Agaga, i toeaina o lana ekalesia, ma sei tatou talatala faatasi, ina ia outou malamalama;

verses.en: Let us reason even as a man reasoneth one with another face to face.
verses.sm: Sei tatou talatala e pei lava ona talatala se tagata o le tasi ma le isi faafesagai.

verses.en: Now, when a man reasoneth he is understood of man, because he reasoneth as a man; even so will I, the Lord, reason with you that you may understand.
verses.sm: O lenei, a talatala se tagata e malamalama le tagata ia te ia, ona e talatala o ia e pei o se tagata; o le a faapea foi ia te A’u, o le Alii, ona talatala faatasi ma outou, ina ia outou malamalama.

verses.en: Wherefore, I the Lord ask you this question—unto what were ye ordained?
verses.sm: O le mea lea, o A’u o le Alii e fesili atu le fesili lenei ia te outou— o le a ea le mea na faauu i ai outou?

verses.en: To preach my gospel by the Spirit, even the Comforter which was sent forth to teach the truth.
verses.sm: E talai atu la’u talalelei e ala i le Agaga, le Fesoasoani lea na auina atu e aoao atu le upumoni.

verses.en: And then received ye spirits which ye could not understand, and received them to be of God; and in this are ye justified?
verses.sm: Ma ona outou talia ai lea o agaga ua lē mafai ona outou malamalama i ai, ma talia i latou e faapea ua mai i le Atua; ma pe ta’umamaina ea outou i lenei mea?

verses.en: Behold ye shall answer this question yourselves; nevertheless, I will be merciful unto you; he that is weak among you hereafter shall be made strong.
verses.sm: Faauta ia outou tali lenei fesili e outou lava; ae ui i lea, o le a Ou alofa mutimutivale atu ia te outou; o ia o lē ua i totonu o outou e vaivai, o le a faamalosia mulimuli ane.

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, he that is ordained of me and sent forth to preach the word of truth by the Comforter, in the Spirit of truth, doth he preach it by the Spirit of truth or some other way?
verses.sm: E moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o ia o lē ua Ou faauuina ma auina atu e talai ana afioga o le upumoni e ala i le Fesoasoani, i le Agaga o le upumoni, e talai atu ea e ia i le Agaga o le upumoni po o se isi ala?

verses.en: And if it be by some other way it is not of God.
verses.sm: Ma afai e talai atu i se isi ala ua lē mai i le Atua lea.

verses.en: And again, he that receiveth the word of truth, doth he receive it by the Spirit of truth or some other way?
verses.sm: O lenei foi, o ia o lē e talia le afioga o le upumoni, e talia ea e ia e ala i le Agaga o le upumoni po o se isi ala?

verses.en: If it be some other way it is not of God.
verses.sm: Afai e talia i se isi ala ua lē mai i le Atua lea.

verses.en: Therefore, why is it that ye cannot understand and know, that he that receiveth the word by the Spirit of truth receiveth it as it is preached by the Spirit of truth?
verses.sm: O lea, aisea ua lē mafai ai ona outou malamalama ma iloa, o ia o lē e mauaina le afioga e ala i le Agaga o le upumoni e maua e ia e pei ona talai atu i le Agaga o le upumoni?

verses.en: Wherefore, he that preacheth and he that receiveth, understand one another, and both are edified and rejoice together.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, o ia o lē e talai atu atoa ma ia o lē e mauaina, e malamalama le tasi i le isi, ma e faagaeetiaina ma olioli faatasi i laua uma.

verses.en: And that which doth not edify is not of God, and is darkness.
verses.sm: Ma o le mea ua lē faagaeetia ua lē mai i le Atua, ma o le pouliuli lea.

verses.en: That which is of God is light; and he that receiveth light, and continueth in God, receiveth more light; and that light groweth brighter and brighter until the perfect day.
verses.sm: O le mea e mai i le Atua o le malamalama lea; ma o ia o lē e mauaina le malamalama, ma tumau pea i le Atua, e mauaina le malamalama atili; ma o lena malamalama o le a susulu tele pea lava pea seia oo i le aso e atoatoa ai.

verses.en: And again, verily I say unto you, and I say it that you may know the truth, that you may chase darkness from among you;
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ma Ou te fai atu ai ina ia mafai ona outou iloa le upumoni, ina ia mafai ona outou tuli ese o le pouliuli mai i totonu o outou;

verses.en: He that is ordained of God and sent forth, the same is appointed to be the greatest, notwithstanding he is the least and the servant of all.
verses.sm: O ia o lē ua faauuina e le Atua ma auina atu, o ia lava lea ua tofia ia avea ma lē ua sili, e ui ina o ia e aupito faatauvaa ma o le auauna a tagata uma.

verses.en: Wherefore, he is possessor of all things; for all things are subject unto him, both in heaven and on the earth, the life and the light, the Spirit and the power, sent forth by the will of the Father through Jesus Christ, his Son.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, ua maua e ia mea uma; ona ua pule o ia i mea uma, o mea uma i le lagi ma i luga o le lalolagi, o le ola ma le malamalama, o le Agaga ma le mana, na auina mai i le finagalo o le Tamā, e ala mai ia Iesu Keriso, lona Alo.

w.en: to the will of the Father

verses.en: But no man is possessor of all things except he be purified and cleansed from all sin.
verses.sm: Ae e leai se tagata na te mauaina mea uma vagana ua ta’umamaina ma faamamaina o ia mai agasala uma.

verses.en: And if ye are purified and cleansed from all sin, ye shall ask whatsoever you will in the name of Jesus and it shall be done.
verses.sm: Ma afai ua ta’umamaina ma faamamaina outou mai agasala uma, soo se mea tou te ole atu ai i le suafa o Iesu o le a faia lava.

verses.en: But know this, it shall be given you what you shall ask; and as ye are appointed to the head, the spirits shall be subject unto you.
verses.sm: Ae ia outou iloa le mea lenei, o le a tuu atu ia te outou mea tou te ole mai ai; ma talu ai ona ua tofia outou i le ulu, o le a i ai agaga i lalo o la outou pule.

verses.en: Wherefore, it shall come to pass, that if you behold a spirit manifested that you cannot understand, and you receive not that spirit, ye shall ask of the Father in the name of Jesus; and if he give not unto you that spirit, then you may know that it is not of God.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, o le a oo mai foi afai tou te vaaia se agaga e faaali mai tou te lē malamalama i ai, ma ua outou lē mauaina lena agaga, ia outou ole atu i le Tamā i le suafa o Iesu; ma afai e lē tuuina mai e ia ia te outou lena agaga, ona outou iloa lea ua lē mai i le Atua.

verses.en: And it shall be given unto you, power over that spirit; and you shall proclaim against that spirit with a loud voice that it is not of God—
verses.sm: Ma o le a tuu atu ia te outou, le mana i luga o lena agaga; ma ia outou alaga atu ma se leo tele faasaga atu i lena agaga ua lē mai i le Atua—

verses.en: Not with railing accusation, that ye be not overcome, neither with boasting nor rejoicing, lest you be seized therewith.
verses.sm: E lē i se tuuaiga ’ina’inā, ina ia lē lofituina outou, pe ma le mitavale po o le sagisagi, nei maua ai outou.

verses.en: He that receiveth of God, let him account it of God; and let him rejoice that he is accounted of God worthy to receive.
verses.sm: O ia o lē na te maua se mea mai i le Atua, ia tau e ia ua mai i le Atua; ma ia tuu atu ia te ia e olioli ua tau agavaa o ia e le Atua na te maua lena mea.

verses.en: And by giving heed and doing these things which ye have received, and which ye shall hereafter receive—and the kingdom is given you of the Father, and power to overcome all things which are not ordained of him—
verses.sm: Ma o le gauai atu ma le faia o ia mea ua outou maua, ma mea o le a outou maua mulimuli ane— ma ua tuu atu ia te outou e le Tamā le malo, ma le mana e manumalo ai i mea uma e lei faauuina e ia—

verses.en: And behold, verily I say unto you, blessed are you who are now hearing these words of mine from the mouth of my servant, for your sins are forgiven you.
verses.sm: Ma faauta, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, amuia lava outou o e o loo faalogo mai i a’u upu nei mai le fofoga o la’u auauna, ona ua faamagaloina a outou agasala mai ia te outou.

verses.en: Let my servant Joseph Wakefield, in whom I am well pleased, and my servant Parley P. Pratt go forth among the churches and strengthen them by the word of exhortation;
verses.sm: Tuu atu i la’u auauna o Iosefa Wakefield, o lē ua Ou fiafia lava i ai, ma la’u auauna o Parley P. Pratt, e o atu i totonu o aulotu ma faamalolosi i latou e ala i le upu apoapoai;

w.en: in whom I am well pleased,

verses.en: And also my servant John Corrill, or as many of my servants as are ordained unto this office, and let them labor in the vineyard; and let no man hinder them doing that which I have appointed unto them—
verses.sm: Ma ia tuu atu foi i la’u auauna o Ioane Corrill, po o le toatele o i latou o a’u auauna ua faauuina i lenei tofi, e galulue i le tovine; ma ia lē tuua se tagata e faalavelave ia te i latou mai le faia o le mea ua Ou tofia i ai i latou—

verses.en: Wherefore, in this thing my servant Edward Partridge is not justified; nevertheless let him repent and he shall be forgiven.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, ua lē ta’uamiotonuina la’u auauna o Eteuati Paterika i lenei mea; ae ui i lea ia tuu atu ia te ia ia salamo ma o le a faamagaloina ai o ia.

verses.en: Behold, ye are little children and ye cannot bear all things now; ye must grow in grace and in the knowledge of the truth.
verses.sm: Faauta, o outou o ni fanau laiti, ma e lē mafai ona outou gafatia mea uma i le taimi nei; e ao ina outou tutupu a’e i le malosi faaleagaga ma i le malamalama o le upumoni.

verses.en: Fear not, little children, for you are mine, and I have overcome the world, and you are of them that my Father hath given me;
verses.sm: Aua le matatau, le fanau laiti e, ona o outou o a a’u outou, ma ua Ou manumalo i le lalolagi, ma o outou o ni o i latou ua tuuina mai e lo’u Tamā ia te a’u;

verses.en: And none of them that my Father hath given me shall be lost.
verses.sm: Ma e leai so i latou o e ua tuuina mai e lo’u Tamā ia te a’u o le a leiloa.

verses.en: And the Father and I are one. I am in the Father and the Father in me; and inasmuch as ye have received me, ye are in me and I in you.
verses.sm: Ma o le Tamā ma A’u ua tasi. Ua i ai A’u i le Tamā ma ua i ai le Tamā ia te A’u; ma talu ai ona ua outou talia a’u, ua outou i ai ia te a’u ma ua Ou i ai ia te outou.

verses.en: Wherefore, I am in your midst, and I am the good shepherd, and the stone of Israel. He that buildeth upon this rock shall never fall.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, ua Ou i ai i lo outou lotolotoi, ma o A’u o le leoleo mamoe lelei, ma le maa faavae o Isaraelu. O ia o lē e ati a’e i luga o lenei papa o le a lē pa’ū lava.

verses.en: And the day cometh that you shall hear my voice and see me, and know that I am.
verses.sm: Ma e oo mai le aso o le a outou faalogo ai i lo’u leo ma vaai mai ai ia te a’u, ma iloa o au lava lea.

verses.en: Watch, therefore, that ye may be ready. Even so. Amen.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, ia mataala ai, ina ia outou saunia. Ua faapea lava. Amene.
